description: This file defines constants, types, and exports related to event types and message content in a Matrix protocol extension, specifically for monitoring types.

methods.name: EventType
methods.description: An object containing string constants representing different event types in the Matrix protocol.

methods.name: RelationType
methods.description: An object containing string constants representing relation types like replace and thread.

methods.name: RoomMessageEventContent
methods.description: A TypeScript type defining the structure of message event content, extending MessageEventContent with optional URL, file, info, and relation properties.
